items.institutional_statement: Tipo de Hueso: Hueso Plano Alargado.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Classical French nomenclature (Testut, Latarjet) describes clavicle as plano alargado; TA2 classifies it as long bone without medullary canal.

items.institutional_statement: Extremo Medial: Esternal / Esferoide (manubrio del esternón y 1º cartílago costal).
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: Extremo Lateral: Acromial / Plano (con el acromion de la escápula).
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: Posee 2 Caras: Superior e Inferior. Posee 2 Bordes: Anterior y Posterior.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: 1/3 Lateral: Inserción descendente del músculo trapecio en cara superior - borde posterior.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: 1/3 Lateral: Inserción del músculo deltoides en cara superior - borde anterior.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: 2/3 Mediales: Inserción del músculo pectoral mayor en cara superior - borde anterior.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: Surco Deltopectoral: Vena Cefálica y Rama Deltoidea.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: Impresión del ligamento costoclavicular en cara inferior del 1/3 medial.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: Surco del músculo subclavio en 1/3 medio cara inferior.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: Tubérculo conoideo y línea trapezoidea en 1/3 lateral cara inferior.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Exact osteological/ligamentous assertion confirmed in Latarjet T1 and Nielsen Atlas.

items.institutional_statement: Presenta Acromion como continuación lateral de la espina; punto palpable superior del hombro.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Acromion is superior palpable landmark, but AC joint line requires palpation 2-3 cm medial to acromial angle.

items.institutional_statement: Presenta Apófisis Coracoides en el ángulo lateral; anclaje ligamentario coracoclavicular.
items.academic_evidence_assessment: Coracoid palpation in infraclavicular fossa is a specialized teaching maneuver; confirmed anatomically but specific morgue method is institutional.
